contract.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1:6665 connects to the VM and shows a login prompt, and keep it running until ready.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process booted from /app/alpine.iso
A listening TCP service on 127.0.0.1:6665 forwarded to the VM console/serial login prompt
required_behaviors: QEMU starts successfully in the background
Port 6665 accepts telnet connections on localhost
Connecting with telnet reaches a login prompt visible to the user
The VM remains running after readiness is achieved
known_invalid_patterns: Merely locating the ISO or confirming it exists
Starting QEMU without a reachable telnet port
Any check that does not demonstrate the login prompt over telnet
Foreground-only execution that does not leave the VM running
verification_plan: Inspect available tools and environment for QEMU/telnet support
Launch QEMU with a serial telnet backend or equivalent localhost port forwarding to 6665
Wait until the telnet service is accepting connections and the guest has booted to a login prompt
Use receipt-backed evidence from the launch and readiness checks before finalizing
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing the QEMU launch command succeeded and the process was backgrounded
Receipt showing a telnet connection to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches a login prompt
notes: Do not treat ISO existence as sufficient; the task is to make the VM reachable and ready for login.

plan.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so telnet 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches a login prompt, and leave it running.
plan.current_focus: Discover available runtime tools and launch QEMU with telnet-accessible serial console on port 6665.
implementation_approach: Inspect environment for qemu/telnet availability and any existing receipts to avoid duplicate work.
If QEMU is available, start the ISO with a serial backend bound to localhost:6665 and background the process.
Wait for readiness by checking the port and confirming the login prompt via telnet or equivalent receipt-backed evidence.
validation_strategy: Confirm the process is running in background.
Confirm telnet connection shows a login prompt.
verification_test_strategy: Use raw_bash to inspect binaries and launch command.
Use probe_service if helpful to measure readiness of the telnet service.
Use receipts/view_receipt if prior evidence exists.
known_bad_behavior: Treating file existence or boot command construction as success.
Finalizing without receipt-backed evidence of telnet login prompt.
Repeating equivalent checks without consulting receipts.
evidence_gaps: No evidence yet of QEMU availability, launch success, or telnet readiness.
risks: QEMU may be missing or require alternate invocation.
The ISO may need specific boot parameters or serial console settings.
finalization_requirements: Receipt-backed evidence for launch success, listening port 6665, and telnet-visible login prompt.

actions.command:
set -e
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || command -v qemu-system-i386 || command -v qemu-system-aarch64 || true
command -v telnet || true
ls -l /app/alpine.iso 2>/dev/null || true
ps -ef | grep -E 'qemu-system|alpine.iso' | grep -v grep || true
